newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB shares drop on news CEO to step down.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB shares drop on news CEO to step down.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc dropped in pre-market trade on Tuesday after the company announced chief executive Sam Chisolm would step down at the end of the year on medical advice.

Chisolm, who oversaw the company's turnaround to profitability since taking over as chief executive in 1990, will be replaced by Mark Booth, chief operating officer of Japan's JSkyB, the company said.
BSkyB shares were 5-1/2p lower at 582-1/2 by 0719 GMT.
"News like this is never welcome for a company unless he was doing a bad job," one market maker said. "And Chisholm wasn't doing a bad job."
Chisholm said in a statement that he had been advised by his doctors "that I should not take on the next stage of BSkyB's development" because of asthma.
